protocol.ordering: Adjacent ABBA/BAAB fresh processes; identical iterations per pair

contract: Identical recursive source algorithms, optimized runtime archive, Clang flags and input depth 14/seed 17. Baseline/current and unbound/bound-token cells are measured in nine adjacent ABBA/BAAB blocks per algorithm/mode, with equal iterations and three measured plus two warmup batches per fresh process. Binding, invocation lifecycle, arithmetic checks, logical admission and cancellation acquire loads remain enabled. All checksums must match independent Fraction/integer/GCD references exactly. This isolates a compiler change; it is not a cross-language ranking or GPU benchmark. Observed cells bind an atomic diagnostic poll counter; allocation/binding/reset are included and the ordinary observed execution path remains enabled.
